description: The first plot in Figure 4.1 illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," ranges from 0 to 6, indicating the number of epochs during the training process. The y-axis, labeled "WER," ranges from 10 to 70, representing the Word Error Rate percentage. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different model configuration: tiny, base, small, medium, and large. The tiny model, represented by a blue line with circle markers, shows a decreasing trend in WER as the number of epochs increases. The base model, depicted by a blue line with square markers, also shows a decreasing trend but starts with a higher WER and ends with a lower WER compared to the tiny model. The small model, represented by an orange line with triangle markers, exhibits a fluctuating trend with a general decrease in WER. The medium model, shown by a green line with diamond markers, starts with a high WER that decreases over time. Lastly, the large model, depicted by a purple line with cross markers, shows a decreasing trend in WER, starting and ending with the lowest WER among all models.
